components.name: Hero Waitlist Link
components.description: The lime opening action anchors to the full Android form in the paper section.
components.html: Join the Android waitlist
components.css: .ds-hero-primary { display:inline-flex; align-items:center; justify-content:center; gap:.6rem; min-height:44px; padding:.72rem 1rem; border-radius:5px; background:var(--color-accent, #b8f53d); color:var(--color-accent-ink, #142d27); font-family:'Strichpunkt Sans Variable',sans-serif; font-size:.92rem; font-weight:720; letter-spacing:-.02em; text-decoration:none; transition:background 180ms cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1),transform 180ms cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1) } .ds-hero-primary:focus-visible { outline:3px solid var(--color-focus, #246b56); outline-offset:4px } .ds-hero-primary:active { transform:translateY(1px) } @media (hover:hover) and (pointer:fine) { .ds-hero-primary:hover { background:var(--color-accent-hover, #a6e22d) } } @media (prefers-reduced-motion:reduce) { .ds-hero-primary { transition:none } }

components.name: Hero Inside Link
components.description: The warm-white secondary anchor leads from the photograph to the paper field guide.
components.html: Take a look inside
components.css: .ds-hero-secondary { display:inline-flex; align-items:center; justify-content:center; gap:.6rem; min-height:44px; padding-inline:.1rem; color:var(--color-hero-text, #fff8ec); font-family:'Ysabeau Variable',sans-serif; font-size:.98rem; text-decoration:underline; text-decoration-thickness:1px; text-underline-offset:.22em; text-shadow:0 2px 14px var(--color-shade-40, rgb(9 32 27 / 40%)); background:var(--color-ink, #142d27) } .ds-hero-secondary:focus-visible { outline:3px solid var(--color-focus, #246b56); outline-offset:4px } @media (hover:hover) and (pointer:fine) { .ds-hero-secondary:hover { text-decoration-thickness:2px } }

components.name: Waitlist Button

components.name: Email Field
components.description: An explicitly labeled fresh-paper field with visible focus, error, and success borders.
components.html: <label class="ds-email-label" for="ds-email">Your email address</label><input class="ds-email" id="ds-email" type="email" placeholder="you@example.com" />
components.css: .ds-email-label { display:block; margin-bottom:.4rem; color:var(--color-ink, #142d27); font-family:'Ysabeau Variable',sans-serif; font-size:.9rem; font-weight:650 } .ds-email { display:block; width:min(100%, 360px); height:54px; padding:.8rem 1rem; border:1px solid var(--color-rule, #b7c1b0); border-radius:5px; background:var(--color-paper-bright, #fbfaf4); color:var(--color-ink, #142d27); font-family:'Ysabeau Variable',sans-serif; font-size:1.05rem; caret-color:var(--color-focus, #246b56) } .ds-email::placeholder { color:var(--color-muted, #546359); opacity:1 } .ds-email:focus-visible { outline:3px solid var(--color-focus, #246b56); outline-offset:4px } .ds-email[aria-invalid=true] { border-color:var(--color-error, #a12c24) } .ds-email[data-success=true] { border-color:var(--color-success, #216246) }

components.name: Masthead Navigation

components.name: Screenshot Choice
components.description: A paper-surface, touch-sized manual control for one of five gallery screenshots.
components.html: <button class="ds-preview" type="button">Explore the map <svg width="14" height="14" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.8" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M8 4H4v4m12-4h4v4M4 16v4h4m12-4v4h-4"/></svg></button>
components.css: .ds-preview { display:inline-flex; align-items:center; justify-content:space-between; gap:.45rem; min-height:44px; min-width:9.5rem; padding:.5rem .65rem; border:1px solid var(--color-rule, #b7c1b0); border-radius:5px; background:transparent; color:var(--color-ink, #142d27); font-family:'Ysabeau Variable',sans-serif; font-size:.93rem; text-align:left; cursor:pointer } .ds-preview svg { color:var(--color-secondary, #40594e) } .ds-preview:focus-visible { outline:3px solid var(--color-focus, #246b56); outline-offset:4px } .ds-preview:active { background:var(--color-paper-deep, #e6e8dd) } @media (hover:hover) and (pointer:fine) { .ds-preview:hover { background:var(--color-paper-bright, #fbfaf4) } }

components.name: Screenshot Tab
components.description: A compact manual viewer selector whose pressed state gains fresh paper and a pencil border.
components.css: .ds-tabs { display:flex; flex-wrap:wrap; gap:.3rem; max-width:100%; background:var(--color-paper, #f1f0e8) } .ds-tab { min-height:44px; padding:.55rem .7rem; border:1px solid transparent; border-radius:5px; background:transparent; color:var(--color-ink, #142d27); font-family:'Ysabeau Variable',sans-serif; font-size:.95rem; text-align:left; cursor:pointer } .ds-tab[aria-pressed=true] { border-color:var(--color-secondary, #40594e); background:var(--color-paper-bright, #fbfaf4) } .ds-tab:focus-visible { outline:3px solid var(--color-focus, #246b56); outline-offset:4px } @media (hover:hover) and (pointer:fine) { .ds-tab:hover { background:var(--color-paper-bright, #fbfaf4) } }

narrative.overview:
Parkdex opens with a real East Sooke landscape. Warm off-white type, a sparing lime action, and an immediately visible matte phone make the island and the product clear in the first viewport. Transparent coastal shading supports legibility while leaving the photograph recognizable. There is no masthead divider or opaque wash over the scene.

The second section returns to the portfolio-derived paper field guide: green ink, bold Strichpunkt type, Ysabeau body copy, a short Caveat sign-off, and real app screenshots in restrained matte hardware. The hero action leads to the full Android waitlist below. Screenshot inspection remains manual and direct, with visible focus and form feedback.
keyCharacteristics: A real Vancouver Island photograph is the opening surface, including behind the masthead.
Warm photo text and one lime action lead to a recognizable badge phone before scrolling.
Paper and green ink carry the gallery, waitlist, and footer below.
Real screenshots remain legible inside restrained matte devices and a manual viewer.

rules.name: The One Marker Rule
rules.body: Keep lime scarce. It identifies a key phrase or action while the landscape, green ink, and paper do the rest.

rules.name: The Clear Landscape Rule
rules.body: Darken the real photograph only enough to read the text. Preserve the image and its crop as the opening material.

rules.name: The Human Annotation Rule
rules.body: Handwriting adds a personal aside around actual product content; it does not carry form labels, navigation, or essential instructions.

rules.name: The Matte Hardware Rule
rules.body: Preserve a dark chassis and distinct bezel at the smallest shipped size. A light-facing edge can define the silhouette; decorative chrome gradients are outside this material language.

rules.name: The Direct Interaction Rule
rules.body: Product previews change only on a visitor's action. Preserve semantic controls, 44px touch targets, visible keyboard focus, and reduced-motion behavior.

dos: Do show a recognizable phone and primary action over the real island photograph before scrolling on phones.
Do use real Parkdex captures at legible sizes and retain the matte chassis around any device mockup.
Do let paper, ink, rules, and spacing establish hierarchy before adding color or shadow.
Do keep the handwritten voice to short personal annotations and the practical copy in Ysabeau.
Do preserve explicit validation, loading, network error, success, and focus states for signup.
donts: Don't spread the lime accent across whole panels or replace the device shell with brand color.
Don't wash the hero photograph in opaque white, add a masthead divider over it, or hide the phone below the waitlist form.
Don't invent polished chrome, detailed branded hardware, or a decorative gradient around screenshots.
Don't auto-advance app captures or make core content depend on animation.
Don't clip gallery or waitlist content merely to force a one-screen layout.
